explanations:
Setup Fee:
This fee covers the engineering work required to process the customer-provided design files and convert them into production-ready engineering data for SMT assembly.

Stencil:
SMT engineers generate the stencil file based on the PCB pad layout, selected component packages, and established industry design guidelines. The stencil is used solely to support the SMT solder paste printing process and will not be shipped with the order.

SMT Assembly Fee:
An automated assembly fee calculated based on the total number of solder joints placed during SMT assembly.

Manual Assembly Fee:
A labor fee for assembly processes that require manual soldering or assembly. The fee is calculated based on the number of solder joints requiring manual soldering.

Extended Components Fee:
For Economic PCBA orders, an additional labor fee applies to extended components that require extra feeder setup or changeover on pick-and-place machines.

Feeder Loading Fee:
For Standard PCBA orders, all basic and extended components require feeder loading on pick-and-place machines. An additional labor fee applies.

X-ray Inspection Fee:
To ensure solder joint quality, X-ray inspection is required for components such as BGA, QFN, and other leadless packages whose solder joints are not visible after SMT assembly.

Handling Fee:
When both Economic PCBA and Standard PCBA are available for the same order, the total price difference between the two options must be at least $14.93. If the difference is less than $14.93, the shortfall is charged as a handling fee.

Single board assembly surcharge:
For bulk orders, a minimum SMT assembly charge of $0.48 per board applies. If the calculated assembly fee is below $0.48 per board, the difference is charged as a surcharge. Panelizing PCBs can help avoid this surcharge.
pcba_fees.faq_summary_(older_wording): 1. What does your quoted price include? The PCB assembly price including: Setup fee: $8.00 Stencil: $1.50 SMT Assembly: $0.0017 per joint Hand-soldering labor fee: $3.5 Manual Assembly: $0.0173 per joint Components cost: Based on the components you choose for assembly Our online quotes will show the exact assembly fee and components cost after you select the parts for assembly. 2. What's your wave soldering service?
pcba_fees.preferred_extended_rule: Preferred Extended Parts"? "Preferred Extended Parts" refers to some of the components that are manually loaded onto the P&P (Pick and Place) machines for assembly. These parts were previously classified as Basic parts, but they have now been categorized as Extended (Preferred) parts. The advantage of Preferred Extended Parts is that they are exempt from the Feeders Loading fee for Economic PCB assembly

pcba_estimate.assumptions: 5 boards, Standard PCBA (Economic is not offered: 0.8 mm boards get Economic only in green HASL, and the ESP32 module and the mic are 'Standard only'); every on-board BOM part placed (DNP and the wired motor left out); fixture fee for 1-29 pcs; components, PCB, packing ($0.50 + $0.00003 x cm²), shipping and any handling fee not included. JLC's live quote after BOM/CPL upload is the authority.

shipping.lcsc_source: https://wmsc.lcsc.com/wmsc/cart/product/getExpress (the cart's shipping estimate; weight = net grams, LCSC adds packaging)

combined_order.how: Order the JLCPCB part shipped to LCSC's Hong Kong warehouse (address in the LCSC FAQ), then pick 'combine with JLCPCB order' at LCSC checkout. LCSC recalculates the shipment by total weight and bills any difference; the JLCPCB order still pays JLC's (domestic) leg to the warehouse.
combined_order.estimate: use lcsc_to_cyprus.parts_plus_jlc_parcel_* for the international leg

vat.jlcpcb: JLCPCB is IOSS-registered: for individual (B2C) orders of US$170 or less, the 19 % VAT is charged at checkout and nothing is due on delivery; above that the parcel is cleared normally (import VAT + courier fee on delivery) unless 'DHL Express (DDP)' is chosen. B2B buyers give a VAT number.
vat.lcsc: LCSC ships FCA / EXW: 'Customers are expected to pay any amount charged by the government or customs at the destination' (duties, taxes, courier fees). LCSC's own pages say nothing about IOSS; forum reports differ. Budget 19 % import VAT + a courier handling fee on delivery.
vat.customs_duty: no customs duty on consignments with an intrinsic value ≤ €150 (EU rule quoted in JLC's article)
